title: On-Policy Self-Training: Data-Free Self-Improvement in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation enables post-training foundation models without relying on stronger external teachers. However, existing approaches rely on ground-truth question-answer pairs, human-curated problem sets, or other supervised signals. In this work, we reformulate on-policy self-distillation as a self-training framework, driven by self-generated question-answer pairs and privileged reasoning demonstrations. We push supervision to the limit: guided solely by coarse, high-level topic descriptions, the model synthesizes its own curriculum of queries and privileged reasoning traces without access to any human-curated prompts or answers. We find that self-distillation on fully synthetic privileged information enables a model to improve across multiple domains while retaining its capabilities on domains it is not self-trained on. translated_title: 在线策略自训练：大语言模型的无数据自我改进
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏使得能够在不依赖更强外部教师的情况下对基础模型进行后训练。然而，现有方法依赖于真实的问题-答案对、人工策划的问题集或其他监督信号。在这项工作中，我们将在线策略自蒸馏重新表述为一个自训练框架，由自生成的问题-答案对和特权推理演示驱动。我们将监督信号推向极限：仅由粗糙的高层级主题描述引导，模型在无需访问任何人工策划的提示或答案的情况下，自行合成查询课程和特权推理轨迹。我们发现，在完全合成的特权信息上进行自蒸馏，能够使模型在多个领域获得改进，同时保留其在未进行自训练的领域上的能力。我们展示了该框架在文本和多模态领域的通用性，并取得了一致的（效果）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需任何数据的在线策略自训练框架，大语言模型仅需粗糙的高层主题描述即可自生成问题-答案对和特权推理演示进行自我改进，在多个领域提升能力的同时保留原有领域的性能。
